arm_registration_policy.source_transform: Resize complete RGBA source by common group scale using LANCZOS, paste all RGBA pixels into zero RGBA base-size canvas at rounded component translation without an alpha paste mask.
arm_registration_policy.mask: Draw replace_polygon_xy in neutral source coordinates, GaussianBlur(feather_px), then multiply by linear vertical fade255 at y<=375 to0 at y>=410.
arm_registration_policy.replacement: PIL Image.composite(aligned_source, exact_base, mask) replaces old arm using real generated torso and transparent pixels; no repaint/alpha-cleanup/source modification.
arm_registration_policy.hand_chin_occlusion: Thinking hand may overlap the lower chin within the explicit arm mask; eyes/upper head stay exact base pixels.
arm_registration_policy.reviewed_candidates: Earlier broad-foot-translation, clipped head ROI and fade330 candidates rejected; final common-width calibration uses whole clean head band and fade begins after old fingertips end.
